privacy_sec1_desc: When you use the Imparo platform, we collect information that you provide to us directly, such as your name, email address, preferred language, and any data related to course submissions (including uploaded documents and images). For Field Agents using the mobile application, we also collect technical data necessary to operate the application securely.
privacy_sec2_desc: We use the collected information to:
privacy_sec2_item3: Communicate with you regarding application status and platform updates
privacy_sec2_item4: Improve the functionality and user experience of our web and mobile applications
privacy_sec3_desc: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal data. When a user account is deleted, the data is archived securely to maintain historical audit trails of submissions, while ensuring the physical user record is removed and email addresses are freed. Uploaded documents are stored securely with restricted access.
privacy_sec4_desc: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. Your data may be shared with designated administrators and back-office staff within the Imparo platform solely for the purpose of evaluating training submissions and managing agent accounts.
privacy_sec5_desc: You have the right to access, update, or request the deletion of your personal information. If you wish to exercise these rights, please contact your administrator.
privacy_sec6_desc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
support_sec1_desc: For any questions, issues, or assistance with the Imparo platform, please reach out to our dedicated support team. We are here to help field agents and administrators alike.
support_faq1_q: How do I download the mobile application?
support_faq1_a: For Android, download the APK directly from the landing page. For iOS, download it directly from the Apple App Store by searching for 'Imparo'.
support_faq2_q: I didn't receive an activation email, what should I do?
support_faq2_a: Check your spam folder first. If it's not there, ask your system administrator to re-send the invitation link or contact our support team.
